The root cause is **recommendationservice latency**. Its p90 jumps at 13:28–13:29, while memory and open sockets rise sharply and its request rate falls. Frontend latency and sockets worsen at the same time, and frontend logs report failures to fetch recommendations. Productcatalogservice shows no comparable latency or resource change, so the dependency evidence points to recommendationservice rather than its callee.

The Jaeger exporter deadline warning is not evidence of a user-request failure; it concerns trace export. The telemetry does not establish why recommendationservice became slow, so memory growth is a clue, not a confirmed cause.
